refit_rule.data: All eligible pre-FINAL TRAIN+DEV events under the frozen exclusion mode.
refit_rule.hyperparameters: Use the exact inner-TRAIN-selected hyperparameters written by discovery; no retuning after DEV.
refit_rule.features: Exact discovery feature schema and 6-hour freshness half-life; no new features, no flow, no PRED-006 hazard features.
refit_rule.chronology: Same strict block-prior visibility rule; source state for target block B may use only source blocks < B.

final_evaluation.baseline: Previous block-complete direct target probability for the same SIG market.
secondary_metrics: directional accuracy at 0.5c and 1c model-dislocation thresholds
final_evaluation.reporting: Report every frozen candidate; do not choose a different winner after looking at FINAL.

required_for_final_confirmation: SIG-market cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound of MAE improvement > 0
confirmation_rule.champion_status: The DEV-frozen champion is CONFIRMED only if it clears all three FINAL conditions.
confirmation_rule.challenger_status: Challengers are reported as robustness checks only; a challenger cannot replace a failed champion post hoc.
confirmation_rule.failure_status: If champion fails FINAL, classify R3 as not freshly confirmed regardless of any isolated challenger result.

execution_boundary.historical_claim: This is a fair-value/repricing study using fills as observations; it is not historical proof of executable arbitrage, maker P&L, or queue position.
execution_boundary.deployment_decision: Any competition deployment requires a separate live execution/risk translation after scientific confirmation.
